title: San Diego Area Navy SEAL Museum Admission Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the legacy of the U.S. Navy SEALs at the Navy SEAL Museum in San Diego, where history comes alive. This museum, situated near the historic Embarcadero, presents authentic artifacts and exhibits that highlight the valor and dedication of these elite warriors. Discover the rich heritage of SEAL Team One, formed in Coronado, and understand the profound impact of their operations across land, sea, and air. A visit to this unique museum not only honors their commitment but also deepens your connection to the local community of retired SEALs and Special Warfare personnel.
